content: {"like":["Enjoys action‑heavy sci‑fi with practical effects (e.g., Dawn of the Planet of the Apes, Waterworld).","Values strong character chemistry in superhero dramas (e.g., Logan, La La Land).","Prefers visually stunning animation in DC animated films (e.g., All‑Star Superman).","Appreciates period authenticity and cinematography in biographical dramas (e.g., The Founder).","Likes unique, immersive settings in fantasy‑adventure series (e.g., Supergirl Season 2)."],"dislike":["Dislikes repetitive musical numbers in family‑friendly animated features (e.g., Moana).","Finds excessive violence and low threat level in superhero films off‑balance (e.g., Logan).","Rejects long runtimes that feel drawn out (e.g., Waterworld, Moana).","Dislikes filler and dated sub‑plots in long‑running TV series (e.g., Supergirl Season 2).","Avoids movies aimed at younger audiences when seeking mature content (e.g., Spider‑Man: Homecoming)."]}
